equipment_model.semantics: Each exercise lists the minimum capability token needed to perform it. A user profile matches an exercise when it has that token; a full_gym profile should include all tokens.
equipment_model.important_note: A truly equipment-free profile has no safe primary vertical-pull or horizontal-row exercise. Require a pull-up bar, resistance bands, or full-gym access for a balanced pulling program.

categories.description: Primary chest-dominant press in a roughly horizontal plane.
Primary shoulder-dominant press overhead or on a steep angle.
Lower-load chest-focused work after a primary press.
Shoulder-abduction work, usually a controlled isolation slot.
Primary lat-focused pull from overhead toward the torso.
Primary horizontal pull for upper back and lats.
Rear-delt and scapular-retraction or external-rotation accessory work.
Hip-hinge compound emphasizing glutes and hamstrings.
Single-joint or unilateral knee-dominant lower-body work.

Plantar-flexion work for gastrocnemius and soleus.
Trunk stability or controlled trunk-flexion/rotation work.
Multi-joint movement that meaningfully trains upper and lower body together.

exercise_catalog.name: Push-Up
exercise_catalog.description: Floor press using body weight for chest, front delts, and triceps.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Keep a straight line from head to heel and lower chest between the hands.

exercise_catalog.name: Incline Push-Up
exercise_catalog.description: Elevated-hand push-up that reduces load while training the pressing pattern.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Use a stable elevated surface and keep ribs down as the chest approaches it.

exercise_catalog.name: Knee Push-Up
exercise_catalog.description: Scaled push-up from the knees for chest and triceps practice.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Maintain a straight line from knees through shoulders; do not lead with the chin.

exercise_catalog.name: Decline Push-Up
exercise_catalog.description: Feet-elevated push-up with a greater upper-chest and shoulder demand.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Brace the trunk and lower under control without letting the low back sag.

exercise_catalog.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
exercise_catalog.description: Narrow-hand push-up emphasizing triceps while retaining a chest press pattern.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Keep elbows tracking back at a comfortable angle rather than flaring wide.
exercise_catalog.best_for: Bodyweight pressing with extra triceps work.

exercise_catalog.name: Archer Push-Up
exercise_catalog.description: Asymmetrical push-up that loads one side more heavily.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Shift toward the working arm while keeping the opposite arm long and controlled.

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercise_catalog.description: Dumbbell press from the floor with a naturally limited bottom range.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Pause upper arms lightly on the floor, then press without shrugging.

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercise_catalog.description: Flat dumbbell press for chest, front delts, and triceps.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Set shoulder blades back, keep feet planted, and press over the shoulders.

exercise_catalog.name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Press
exercise_catalog.description: Dumbbell press with palms facing each other for a shoulder-friendly option.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Keep wrists stacked over elbows and avoid bouncing at the bottom.
exercise_catalog.best_for: Pressing when a neutral grip feels better.

exercise_catalog.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercise_catalog.description: Flat barbell press targeting chest, front delts, and triceps.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Retract shoulder blades, plant feet, and press from lower chest toward over shoulders.

exercise_catalog.name: Machine Chest Press
exercise_catalog.description: Guided chest press with stable resistance and simple setup.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Set handles at mid-chest and keep shoulders down as you press.

exercise_catalog.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
exercise_catalog.description: Guided-bar flat press for chest and triceps.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Place the bench so the bar reaches the lower chest with wrists stacked.

exercise_catalog.name: Pike Push-Up
exercise_catalog.description: Inverted bodyweight press emphasizing shoulders.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Hips stay high; lower the crown of the head toward the floor in front of the hands.

exercise_catalog.name: Box Pike Push-Up
exercise_catalog.description: Pike push-up with feet elevated on a stable box or bench.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Stack hips over shoulders as much as mobility allows and control the descent.
exercise_catalog.best_for: A scalable bridge to stronger overhead pressing.

exercise_catalog.name: Wall Handstand Hold
exercise_catalog.description: Inverted isometric shoulder-strength exercise at a wall.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Push tall through the shoulders and keep ribs tucked while breathing steadily.
exercise_catalog.best_for: Advanced overhead stability, not a novice default.

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercise_catalog.description: Seated or standing overhead dumbbell press for shoulders and triceps.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Brace the trunk and press up slightly back without flaring the ribs.

exercise_catalog.name: Half-Kneeling Dumbbell Press
exercise_catalog.description: Single-arm overhead press from a half-kneeling position.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Squeeze the glute of the down knee and keep the torso tall as you press.

exercise_catalog.name: Arnold Press
exercise_catalog.description: Rotating dumbbell shoulder press with a long shoulder range.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Rotate smoothly without forcing range or letting the elbows drift behind the body.
exercise_catalog.best_for: Varied dumbbell shoulder work for experienced lifters.

exercise_catalog.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercise_catalog.description: Guided overhead press for shoulders and triceps.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Set the seat so handles begin around ear level and keep ribs down.

exercise_catalog.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercise_catalog.description: Standing barbell press targeting shoulders and triceps.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Squeeze glutes, brace hard, and move the head through once the bar clears it.

exercise_catalog.name: Landmine Press
exercise_catalog.description: Angled barbell press with a shoulder-friendly arc.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Press up and forward while keeping the working shoulder away from the ear.
exercise_catalog.best_for: Users who prefer an angled pressing path.

exercise_catalog.name: Wide Push-Up
exercise_catalog.description: Push-up with a wider hand position to bias chest contribution.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Use a pain-free hand width and keep elbows from flaring excessively.

exercise_catalog.name: Paused Push-Up
exercise_catalog.description: Push-up with a deliberate pause near the bottom for control.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Pause while keeping the torso rigid, then press without losing position.

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercise_catalog.description: Chest isolation movement using a controlled arc with dumbbells.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Keep a soft elbow bend and stop before the shoulder stretches uncomfortably.

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
exercise_catalog.description: Dumbbell press performed while squeezing the weights together.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Maintain inward pressure throughout and press smoothly over the chest.
exercise_catalog.best_for: Simple chest accessory without a large stretch.

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercise_catalog.description: Controlled overhead dumbbell arc training chest and lats.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Keep ribs down and use a comfortable shoulder range rather than chasing depth.

exercise_catalog.name: Cable Fly
exercise_catalog.description: Cable chest fly with continuous resistance through the range.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Move from the shoulders with a slight elbow bend and avoid shrugging.

exercise_catalog.name: Pec Deck
exercise_catalog.description: Machine fly for controlled chest isolation.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Keep the chest tall and bring pads together without rounding the shoulders forward.

exercise_catalog.name: Standing Cable Chest Press
exercise_catalog.description: Single or double cable press with a standing trunk-stability demand.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Stagger stance, brace, and press without rotating toward the cable.

exercise_catalog.name: Band Lateral Raise
exercise_catalog.description: Lateral shoulder raise against band resistance.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Raise arms in the scapular plane and stop around shoulder height.

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise

exercise_catalog.form_cue: Lead with elbows, keep a slight bend, and avoid swinging the torso.

exercise_catalog.name: Leaning Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercise_catalog.description: Lateral raise performed while lightly leaning for a longer loaded range.

exercise_catalog.name: Seated Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercise_catalog.description: Seated lateral raise that limits momentum.

exercise_catalog.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercise_catalog.description: Single-arm cable lateral raise with smooth tension.

exercise_catalog.name: Machine Lateral Raise

exercise_catalog.name: Cable Y Raise

exercise_catalog.name: Band Triceps Pressdown

exercise_catalog.name: Bench Dip

exercise_catalog.name: Diamond Push-Up

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback

exercise_catalog.name: Reverse Pec Deck

exercise_catalog.name: Band Biceps Curl

exercise_catalog.name: Chin-Up Eccentric

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl

exercise_catalog.name: Cable Biceps Curl

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat

exercise_catalog.name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift

exercise_catalog.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift

exercise_catalog.name: Trap-Bar Deadlift

exercise_catalog.name: Cable Pull-Through

exercise_catalog.name: Lying Leg Curl

exercise_catalog.name: Band Glute Kickback

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Frog Pump

exercise_catalog.name: Band Wood Chop
exercise_catalog.description: Controlled diagonal band pull for trunk rotation.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Rotate through upper back and hips smoothly rather than yanking with arms.

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Suitcase Carry
exercise_catalog.description: Single-sided loaded carry challenging grip, trunk, and gait.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Walk slowly with ribs stacked over pelvis and resist leaning toward the weight.

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
exercise_catalog.description: Seated loaded trunk rotation exercise.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Rotate under control with a tall chest; reduce range if low back discomfort occurs.

exercise_catalog.name: Cable Pallof Press
exercise_catalog.description: Anti-rotation press with a cable stack.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Set cable at chest height and prevent the torso from turning as arms extend.

exercise_catalog.name: Cable Wood Chop
exercise_catalog.description: Controlled diagonal cable rotation for trunk and hips.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Move smoothly through a pain-free range and do not jerk the stack.

exercise_catalog.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercise_catalog.description: Long-lever anti-extension exercise using an ab wheel.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Keep glutes tight and stop before the low back arches.

exercise_catalog.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercise_catalog.description: Hanging trunk-flexion exercise with grip and shoulder demand.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Avoid swinging; curl pelvis upward rather than merely lifting thighs.

exercise_catalog.name: Burpee
exercise_catalog.description: Floor-to-stand conditioning movement combining squat, plank, and jump.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Step back instead of jumping when needed and land softly with knees tracking toes.

exercise_catalog.name: Bear Crawl
exercise_catalog.description: Quadruped locomotion training shoulders, hips, and trunk control.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Keep knees low, move opposite hand and foot, and maintain a quiet torso.

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Thruster
exercise_catalog.description: Squat-to-overhead-press combination for legs, shoulders, and conditioning.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Drive from legs, then finish the press with ribs controlled.

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Clean to Press
exercise_catalog.description: Dumbbell clean followed by overhead press.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Keep weights close, catch softly at shoulders, then press with a braced torso.

exercise_catalog.name: Dumbbell Renegade Row
exercise_catalog.description: Plank-position unilateral row challenging back, shoulders, and trunk stability.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Use a wide stance and row without twisting hips toward the weight.

exercise_catalog.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercise_catalog.description: Explosive hip-hinge swing for glutes and conditioning.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Hinge rather than squat; snap hips and let the bell float without lifting with arms.

exercise_catalog.name: Barbell Power Clean
exercise_catalog.description: Explosive barbell lift from floor or hang to front rack.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Learn under qualified coaching; keep bar close and receive it with soft knees.

exercise_catalog.name: Sled Push
exercise_catalog.description: Loaded sled drive for legs, trunk, and conditioning.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Lean into handles with a neutral spine and take short powerful steps.
exercise_catalog.best_for: Low-skill gym conditioning with leg emphasis.

exercise_catalog.name: Farmer's Carry
exercise_catalog.description: Bilateral loaded carry training grip, trunk, posture, and gait.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Stand tall, keep shoulders down, and walk under control without rushing.

exercise_catalog.name: Barbell Deadlift-Row-Press Complex
exercise_catalog.description: Multi-movement barbell sequence combining hinge, row, and press.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Use light loads and maintain strict form on every component before adding speed.
exercise_catalog.best_for: Advanced conditioning variety, never a beginner default.

exercise_catalog.name: Band Chest Press
exercise_catalog.description: Anchored standing band press for chest, shoulders, and triceps.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Use a staggered stance, keep ribs down, and press without twisting.
exercise_catalog.best_for: Portable pressing when dumbbells are unavailable.

exercise_catalog.name: Band Front Squat
exercise_catalog.description: Band-resisted squat with the band held in a front-rack position.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Keep feet rooted and stand by extending knees and hips together.

exercise_catalog.name: Bodyweight Good Morning
exercise_catalog.description: Unloaded hip hinge using hands behind the head or crossed on the chest.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Send hips back with soft knees and keep the spine long throughout.

exercise_catalog.name: Band Romanian Deadlift
exercise_catalog.description: Band-loaded hip hinge for hamstrings and glutes.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Stand on the band, keep it close to legs, and finish by squeezing glutes.

exercise_catalog.name: Band-Assisted Squat
exercise_catalog.description: Squat using an anchored band for balance or assistance.
exercise_catalog.form_cue: Use the band only as much as needed and keep knees tracking over toes.
exercise_catalog.best_for: Beginners who need balance support while squatting.
